3H-Qnb and 3H-Spiroperidolt binding sites were localized in the presynaptic and postsynaptic site, respectively, of muscarinic and dopaminergic neurons.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

3H-QBN and 3H-SPIR binding sites are located at both presynaptic and postsynaptic sites of the cholinergic neuron and the dopamine neuron, respectively, and that the 3H-QN and 3H-SP binding sites are localized at the postsnynaptic site of cholinergic neuron, respectively.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the binding of muscarinic and dopamine receptors in the human brain is altered by the pathological process of the striatonigral neuron.
